title: 2.7.3 Individual PA Part 3: Find and Fix
description: Four broken programs. Identify each bug, name its type (syntax / runtime / logic), and fix it. One sitting; the checklist shows which symptom remains.

requirements.title: Bug 1 — the program does not run at all
requirements.description: The file is valid JavaScript and reaches the end.
requirements.hint: The console names the line it gave up on. Go to that line and read it one character at a time.

requirements.title: Bug 2 — the program stops part way through
requirements.description: Nothing in the file uses a name that was never declared.
requirements.hint: A ReferenceError always names the thing it could not find. That name is the clue.

requirements.title: Bug 3 — the savings total is wrong
requirements.description: The holiday-week skip does not swallow the deposit it is meant to skip.
requirements.hint: Work out on paper what the savings should say for four weeks, then compare. If the two disagree, ask which week the skip actually skips.

requirements.title: Bug 4 — the loop counter never advances
requirements.description: The counter increments on every round, including the ones that continue.
requirements.hint: In a while loop, continue jumps past the increment. The update must run on EVERY pass -- move it above the continue, or restructure as a for.

requirements.title: All four bugs are named
requirements.description: A comment beside each fix names its kind: syntax, runtime or logic.
requirements.hint: Four fixes, four comments -- one per bug.
